title: Referrals and Authorizations Entry Conditions and Requesting Parties Appendix
content:
Each **Referrals and Authorizations** type has its own entry conditions: who must request it, whether clinical notes must accompany the request, and the program conditions the request must document. A figure of 0 in this appendix means the condition does not apply to that type.

## Appendix 1. Requesting party and clinical documentation

| Authorization type | Must be requested by | Clinical notes must accompany the request |
|---|---|---|
| Specialty Care Referral | the primary care manager | no |
| Rehabilitative Therapy Referral | the primary care manager | yes |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | the ordering provider | yes |
| Home Health Care Authorization | the ordering physician | yes |
| Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization | a TRICARE-authorized diagnosing provider | yes |
| Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization | the attending physician | yes |
| Inpatient Mental Health Authorization | the admitting facility | yes |

## Appendix 2. Program conditions

| Authorization type | Qualifying diagnosis or condition to document | Youngest age (months) | Standardized outcome measures with each request | Parent or caregiver training sessions per authorization (minimum) | Patient must be homebound | Consecutive prior inpatient days | Admission within this many days of hospital discharge | Rental months after which equipment passes to the patient |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Specialty Care Referral | none | 0 | no | 0 | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Rehabilitative Therapy Referral | none | 0 | no | 0 | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | a certificate of medical necessity from the ordering provider | 0 | no | 0 | no | 0 | 0 | 13 |
| Home Health Care Authorization | a homebound patient with a skilled care need | 0 | no | 0 | yes | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization | autism spectrum disorder diagnosed by a TRICARE-authorized diagnosing provider | 18 | yes | 6 | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization | a skilled care need following a qualifying hospital stay | 0 | no | 0 | no | 3 | 30 | 0 |
| Inpatient Mental Health Authorization | danger to self or others, or an acute psychiatric crisis | 0 | no | 0 | no | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Notes on the appendix

- Only the Home Health Care Authorization requires the patient to be homebound.
- Only the Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization sets a minimum age (18 months), requires outcome measures and sets a parent training minimum (6 sessions).
- Only the Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization requires a prior hospital stay (3 consecutive inpatient days) and admission within 30 days of the hospital discharge; for every other type the readmission window figure is 0.
- Only the Durable Medical Equipment Authorization has a capped rental period (13 rental months).

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A request for applied behavior analysis for a child of 17 months does not meet the 18-month minimum; one for a child of 18 months does.
